en: Color multi-view postcard of the Black Sea resort Neptun. Front shows a large lake with sailboats and a distinctive triangular‑roofed floating pavilion/restaurant; a crowded sandy beach with flagpoles; tourists riding family bikes beside a bus; and a villa-like resort building. The word "NEPTUN" is printed in large yellow letters on a red panel. The reverse has Romanian layout text for a postal card, a blue 2L Posta Română stamp (Arta Populară), Bucharest cancellation dated 31.7.84, and a red handwritten message and address.
